On October 13, 2026, the Philippine Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, approved the prosecution's request to withdraw most of the charges against Vice President Sara Duterte. The prosecution dropped Articles I, III, and IV, even though it had already presented evidence on two of those three articles, and it kept Article II. The defense and some senator-judges objected.

In response to one of those senator-judges, Presiding Officer Chiz Escudero said that "this has happened in the United States on several occasions, given our research on the matter." You can hear the remark at 11m 5s in this video.

Which, if any, U.S. impeachment trials involved prosecutors withdrawing selected articles after presenting evidence on them?

Does purchasing video games from DRM-free sources grant you full ownership of the game, or just a license to use the game for certain purposes (including playing it, obviously) just like purchasing them from DRM-infused sources? Examples of DRM-free video game sources include GOG.com and Itch.io.
